anya (pm): Heads up — Acme Health wants API parity with CompetitorX's /generate-chat. They say function-calling + strict JSON schema enforcement are blockers for switching from pilot. Thoughts?

mike (eng): Quick q — do they need identical wire format or just same behavior? We already support function calling but our payload shape/field names differ.

sophie (ae): Their compliance group also flagged audit logs & residency. They'll only sign Dedicated if we show a short path that meets their checklist.

raul (sales): They're at EVAL2. If we can demo a compatibility shim within 4–6 weeks, we can close the deal. They have legal motion but timeline is the gating factor.

anya (pm): Proposed options: 
1) Compatibility adapter layer that rewrites incoming CompetitorX-style requests -> our API (fast, partial parity).
2) Full spec-level support: match wire format, schema enforcement, structured output semantics (heavier, more infra).
Which do we prefer for an initial ship?

mike (eng): Adapter = low risk. We can implement a translation layer that maps competitor fields + function call wrappers. Limitations: streaming semantics and some edge-case error shapes won't match 1:1.
Estimates: adapter ~1.5 dev-weeks + tests. Full spec ~6–8 dev-weeks + infra (schema validation, streaming adjustments). Adapter behind feature-flag + canary sounds reasonable.

jordan (design): UX note — ensure error mapping doesn't expose internal debug fields. Adapter should translate errors back to competitor shapes so integrators don't have to change clients.

anya (pm): Draft launch criteria for adapter (minimal):
- parity for main success path (function call invoke + response mapping)
- feature flag + canary to 10% of traffic
- migration docs + sample mapping guide
- audit/logging to satisfy compliance (persist call metadata, masking PII)
- sales/legal signoff on roadmap commitment to full spec
Can engineering commit to that baseline?

mike (eng): Canary & feature flag yes. Audit logs need a small change in logging pipeline (+1 week). Masking PII we already have helpers for.

sophie (ae): I'll confirm with Acme what exact schema fields they require for compliance. They said schema enforcement for output is the big concern. Adapter acceptable for initial term if we commit to the full spec with a target date.

raul (sales): Proposed commercial motion: 6 months discounted Dedicated + firm roadmap commitment to full spec in Q3. If we can get adapter in 4–6 weeks we'll close. Legal will want the commitment in the SOW.

anya (pm): OK — action items: 
- mike: scope adapter + firm estimate by EOD today
- eng-infra (ops): scope logging change for audit trails (owner?)
- sophie: confirm exact schema fields with customer and get written acceptance of adapter path
- raul: draft draft term sheet for partner discount + roadmap clause
Schedule: quick sync tomorrow 10:00am to align. :calendar:

ops-bot: deployed branch parity-adapter to staging — integration tests failing on schema-edge-case. CI logs: https://ci.internal/12345 (failing test: nested_callback_payload)

mike (eng): saw CI. Likely nested callbacks mapping mismatch, triaging now. Will update by EOD.

anya (pm): Thanks all. We'll keep decisions here. If adapter timeline slips we escalate to leadership for tradeoff on scope. :thumbsup:
